result.document_summary: Boston.gov page describing the Housing Stability Notification Act, which requires landlords to give tenants a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources and to notify the City when ending a tenancy.
result.notes: The page describes only notice and reporting duties tied to ending a tenancy (notice to quit or non-renewal). It states no allowed eviction causes, relocation assistance, or other substantive just-cause standard, and no rent, deposit, fee, screening, or algorithmic pricing rule. The notice requirement is not a just-cause regime, so no in-scope rule is extracted.
